summary: Soligenix, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its Phase 3 FLASH2 trial for HyBryte was halted for futility per the Data Monitoring Committee's interim analysis. The company announced it will evaluate all strategic options, including merger/acquisition opportunities and advancing dusquetide for Behçet's Disease. No specific deal terms, prices, or advisors were disclosed. The press release was attached as Exhibit 99.1. This is an early-stage strategic review triggered by a clinical failure; watch for potential M&A, partnering, or restructuring moves as the company assesses its path forward.
